edition.en: Text as given on Chinese Wikisource; the later commentary printed with it is not included.
edition.zh: 据维基文库；不收附印的后人评注。

basis.en: Northern Song prose; the author died in 1073.
basis.zh: 北宋散文，作者卒于 1073 年。

note.en: Zhou Dunyi's short essay of 1063 on the lotus, which rises from the mud unstained. In a hundred and nineteen characters it sets three flowers against three ways of living. Notice the last turn: he asks who shares his love of the lotus, and does not answer.
note.zh: 周敦颐 1063 年的短文，写出淤泥而不染的莲。一百一十九个字，以三种花对照三种活法。留意最后一转：他问谁与他同爱莲，却不作答。

excerpt.orig: 予獨愛蓮之出淤泥而不染，濯清漣而不妖
excerpt.en: I alone love the lotus: it rises out of the mud and is not stained by it; it is washed by clear ripples and is not showy.
excerpt.zh: 予独爱莲之出淤泥而不染，濯清涟而不妖
